findings.message: is there a reason why we choose to panic in this particular case rather than return an error? IOW, is this is an unexpected error here that should never happen?
findings.tp_fp_justification: socket 移入共享 Mutex 后先锁内读 can_send 再 drop 重新 lock 发送，窗口内并发 poll/远端关闭可使发送失败，.expect 在可触发路径 panic。作者承认残留并 'Will fix'，4932a2e44b 改为返回错误。
